title: 函館スプリントSの後に・カワイイ魅力

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite finishing the Hakodate Sprint Stakes, Curren Chan feels a little underwhelmed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, when she sees the passionate response from her fans on Umatter…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She remembers that she only needs a moment to captivate people's hearts in a sprint.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, she doesn't want her fame to end as quickly as a sprint does. She wants to keep drawing in fans with her cuteness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With that as her overall goal, she heads to summer camp to prepare for the Sprinters Stakes.
